Version 1.0.1

- Added documentation: LICENSE, README.md, and README_zh.md files included.
- Added example assets: input images, example output SVG, STL, and render image added to assets.
- Updated workflow instructions in SKILL.md (notable change: updated virtual environment and pip usage to Unix-style paths).
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md deleted.

Initial release of image-to-3d-part-stl skill.

- Converts 2D images with labeled dimensions into accurate 3D STL part models for engineering and 3D printing use.
- Provides a workflow: analyze image & dimensions, draw/confirm an annotated SVG floorplan, then generate a precise 3D model script.
- Supports iterative modifications based on user feedback, allowing repeated blueprint and STL updates.
- Modular structure for easy extension and secondary development.
- Requires user confirmation of 2D SVG before proceeding to 3D STL model export.
